title: Administrar temas
resetDetail: Restore this built-in theme’s original colors, fonts, display settings and file rules? Explicit Settings preferences will remain.
deleteDetail: Delete this custom theme? If active, a built-in theme will be selected.
name: Nombre del tema
builtinHint: Your changes are stored separately. Reset to Default restores the original theme.
rulesHint: Language defaults apply first. The longest matching file extension wins. Explicit User and Workspace settings take precedence.
languageRule: Match a language instead of an extension
rulePlaceholder: jsx, yml, d.ts or a language ID
overridden: Overridden by an explicit Settings preference. Reset that preference in Settings to use this theme value.
missingFont: Font “{{font}}” is unavailable. Using a bundled fallback.
invalidRule: Enter a valid language or file extension.
duplicateRule: A rule for this extension or language already exists.
conflict: This theme changed on disk. Reload it or explicitly overwrite the file.
invalidColor: Enter a hexadecimal color such as #7aa2ff or #7aa2ff80.
overriddenUser: Overridden by User Settings. Reset that preference in Settings to use the theme value.
overriddenWorkspace: Overridden by Workspace Settings. Reset that preference in Settings to use the theme value.
